jira._comment_commit_mode: "update" advances the tickets a commit references and reports anything outside their scope. "create" is the old behaviour: one new ticket per commit. Update keeps the board a plan instead of a changelog.

confluence._comment_spec_pages: Maps a ticket label to the Confluence page that specifies it. When work diverges from a ticket, the sync comments on that ticket's spec page — the plan's owner is the person who needs to know reality differed from it.
confluence._comment_comment_on_specs: Set false to record divergence on pages only, without commenting.

_comment_docs: Auto-generated documentation. Derived state, regenerated in full each run — same contract as the Confluence pages.

docs._comment_scope_trailer: Drift the author declares outright. Path matching cannot see scope creep inside a file the ticket already claims, so this is the channel for it.

_comment_exclude: Commits whose subject starts with any of these are ignored entirely. Covers the sync's own derived-state commits and repo housekeeping — neither is work worth reporting on.
_comment_exclude_paths: Generated files. Ignored when classifying a commit, so derived state never counts as work or triggers a false divergence.
_comment_areas: Maps changed file paths to a human-readable area. First matching prefix wins; order matters.
